snippet.title: In Hope Voiden Trailer - 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase
snippet.description:
A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters—and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery. This trailer shows new gameplay, as revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726180
